$comment: Docs versions, see scripts/build-site.mjs. /help/ shows `stable` (the latest release), built from its ref: a branch, so docs fixes can be backported to it. /help/next/ shows master. Archives (/help/v/<version>/) are older releases, built from their release tag or branch. On a release: move the current stable into archives, and point stable at the new release's branch.
